acceptance.compositeRule: Every declared vector is required; one composite case counts once. Entry presence is not PASS.

cases.expected: Reject mismatched source, candidate, toolchain, fixtures, collector, platform or permissions before dispatch
Every fixed case has a real callable phase-correct entry; PRE never requires POST output
Failure identity retains phase, executor, original request, baseline and facts separately from hypothesis
A minimal verification distinguishes preparation errors from product errors without certifying a hypothesis
Retry inherits bounded authority and rejects unchanged deterministic failures and two no-progress repair rounds
Actual GitHub response loss reconciles the original accepted job without a second dispatch
Actual GitLab revision conflict restores exact reviewed bindings rather than blindly refreshing
Installed service and Host reentry retain identity, original request and correction records
Current evidence qualification distinguishes actual execution from authorized reuse
Permission, project, expiry, owner and approval boundaries remain enforced
Installed Codex Expert completes HTTP MCP correction with zero Runtime model calls
Current installed service, Expert, MCP and CLI read back correction and immutable history
Independent branches continue; failed prerequisites block dependants; global invalidations stop affected execution
Unrelated candidate change permits qualification, direct/transitive changes require execution, reuse traces original run
Input changes invalidate qualification; unknown dynamic/external dependencies fall back conservatively
Required differential set is complete and cannot silently reuse incomplete or invalid outcomes
Original execution is immutable and reused labels cannot be substituted for source evidence
A reused PASS cannot establish environment state or erase flaky history
Request, directory, Host, instance and restart cannot reset budgets; deadline permits observation only
Six-case dependency fixture compares selective and full execution for known edits and unknown graph
Owner repository tool adapters report protocol failures, actual failure and success without false PASS or invented costs
Exact target chat verifies delivered installed Runtime identity and connection
Transfer exact Ontology source, pending patches, failures and valid grants without reviving expired budgets
Perform actual subsequent Ontology correction through installed Runtime, including branch handling, differential plan and evidence

requiredBehavior: Phase-correct preflight before costly dispatch; execution bindings and fixture readiness must be real.
Append-only facts and hypotheses; no Runtime LLM or arbitrary execution endpoint.
Use existing stage request/reconcile/advance; UNKNOWN never implies redispatch.
Independent authorized branches continue after unrelated failure; dependent branches remain blocked; serial stateful groups stay indivisible.
Global candidate, environment integrity, authority or resource invalidity halts affected work.
Collect faults on fixed RC, batch isolated repairs, targeted regressions then freeze next RC.
Differential execution includes failures, new and unrun cases, affected or uncertain inputs, invalid evidence and fixed final must-run checks.
PASS_REUSED is a new current qualification, never a rewritten raw execution or a stage-status override.
Reuse requires original executed evidence, complete dependency closure, published Harness policy, validity and current assessment; unknown input fails closed.
Reuse never prepares live state or hides initial failures/flaky history.
Retries preserve cumulative authority, deadline and attempts across request, directory, Host and instance changes; two no-progress repairs stop that path.
Final candidate identity, package install/start/public entry/resources/key integration and affected upgrade/recovery actually execute.
Actual usage only; absent costs remain unknown; no new token quota or cost estimator.

compatibility.legacyQualification: Unknown qualification schema rejected; old receipts retained
compatibility.rollback: New evidence remains archived; restore verified pre-upgrade state for old binary, never open newer data with old binary
compatibility.ownerPolicy: Harness owns quality semantics; check published contract before reuse activation; insufficient contract blocks formal reuse rather than inventing compatibility

tools.note: Version and package identity must be bound before introduction; reports do not replace product or standard acceptance.

exclusions: No ninth lifecycle stage or new orchestration engine
No additional Dashboard page or monitor edit/execute/approval controls
No Ontology product fixes in Runtime chat before delivery handoff
No automatic business asset or L3 changes
No resetting expired windows or unlimited retries
No release authority inferred from implementation approval
